name: Create Light/Darkness
description: Sheds bright and/or dim light out to a set radius, or fills an area with magical darkness that even darkvision can't see through — the same source-radius shape in opposite directions.

mechanics.text: While active, this record's own featureParams.mode picks the direction: `light` sheds bright light out to featureParams.brightRadius feet (when set) and dim light out to featureParams.dimRadius feet, both measured from the source; `darkness` fills a sphere out to featureParams.radius feet with magical darkness — even darkvision can't see through it, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.
